summary: Comprehensive architectural and UI/UX implementation plan for isolating and upgrading the Vertical Shaft underground face mapping workflow, including Full Face vs. Half Face (Left/Right Half + Center Median Open/Closed), 4-quadrant wall mapping (NORTH-EAST 0-90°, EAST-SOUTH 90-180°, SOUTH-WEST 180-270°, WEST-NORTH 270-360°), 2D Face & Strip Align canvases, 3D Joint Inspector vertical cylinder modeling, and FEM/DEM continuum + discontinuum stability calculations.
